name: Default
shortDescription: SSO login gateway for Nginx auth_request: protected sites check its /validate endpoint and visitors sign in through Google, GitHub or any OIDC provider.

alerts.message: Vouch Proxy needs an OAuth app at your identity provider. Register one with the callback URL https://<your domain>/auth, then set OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET and redeploy. OAUTH_PROVIDER defaults to github; for a generic OIDC provider set it to oidc and fill OAUTH_AUTH_URL, OAUTH_TOKEN_URL, OAUTH_USER_INFO_URL and OAUTH_SCOPES (openid,email,profile).

Serve Vouch Proxy on a custom domain under the same parent domain as the apps you protect (for example vouch.example.com) and set VOUCH_DOMAINS to that parent domain (example.com) so the session cookie reaches them. List allowed users in VOUCH_WHITELIST (comma separated). With no whitelist only users whose email is in VOUCH_DOMAINS get through. Your reverse proxy must send each protected request to /validate and redirect 401 responses to /login.
